create.name: Ngakma Nor'dzin Pamo
create.bio:
Ngakma Nor'dzin Pamo is a lama of the Aro gTér, a non-monastic lineage within the Nyingma school of Tibetan Buddhism, and lives in Cardiff. She took up meditation with Tibetan teachers in Britain in the early 1980s, later became a close student of Khandro Déchen and Ngak'chang Rinpoche, and in 1989 was ordained as a ngakma, the first Western woman to receive this householder ordination in the Nyingma tradition. Raised in the English Midlands, she spent years leading community education classes before accepting personal students in the 1990s.

She teaches together with her husband, Ngakpa 'ö-Dzin Tridral. The two lead Aro Ling Cardiff, now mostly an online group that meets on Zoom each Monday evening for silent sitting, yogic song and a short reading or talk. Their main work is apprenticeship: a small circle of students who practise with them over many years, with retreats at the lineage's Welsh centre, Drala Jong, and online. Her books include Spacious Passion, on the four thoughts that turn the mind towards practice; Relaxing into Meditation, a gentle step-by-step guide that grew out of her classes; Battlecry of Freedom, a commentary on the 59 slogans of Tibetan mind training; and Illusory Advice, written with her husband. Her teaching is warm, humorous and practical, treating family and working life as the ground of practice.

books.title: Spacious Passion
books.author: Ngakma Nor'dzin Pamo
books.description: Her first book, a commentary on the four thoughts that turn the mind towards practice: the value of a human life, impermanence, karma and the cycle of dissatisfaction. Each chapter closes with questions from students and her answers. Published by Aro Books worldwide in 2009.

books.title: Relaxing into Meditation
books.author: Ngakma Nor'dzin Pamo
books.description: A plain, step-by-step course that moves from simple relaxation and breathing exercises into sitting meditation, shaped by her years of community classes. Published by Aro Books worldwide in 2010.

books.title: Illusory Advice
books.author: Ngakma Nor'dzin Pamo, Ngakpa 'ö-Dzin Tridral
books.description: Written with her husband, this collects email exchanges with their students on practice, family life, relationships and what it means to have a teacher. Published by Aro Books worldwide in 2016.

courses.title: Vajrayana Apprenticeship in the Aro gTér Lineage
courses.description: A long-term training in which a small group of students practise and study with Ngakma Nor'dzin and Ngakpa 'ö-Dzin. It includes apprentice-only retreats at Drala Jong in Wales and on Zoom, and suits people who want to practise within ordinary working and family life.

free_resources.title: Monday Meditations
free_resources.description: A weekly online session on Monday evenings, UK time, open to anyone. It combines silent sitting, sung practice and a short reading or teaching from the couple.

free_resources.title: Silent sitting
free_resources.description: Written instructions for shi-nè, the basic sitting practice of the group: ten minutes a day of letting thoughts dissolve on the out-breath, with breath counting as a support when the mind is busy.
